mission: Buy one adult ticket for Saturday's match

frames.caption: Chaos opens the shop. A cookie banner already covers the bottom of the screen.
Saturday's match. The seat map takes 12.3s to load; her patience is 5s.
Seat 6 looks available. It is sold, and she is bounced back to the fixtures list.
Third try: checkout opens. The order summary says £22.50.
She types the card number with spaces. It is cut at 16 characters: "That card number is pants".
After the card error the form comes back empty, so the retry fails: "Hold your horses".
Order confirmed, decided by the browser. But £25.00 was taken for a £22.50 seat.
